Swansea ended last season with three wins and two draws from their final six Championship matches, scoring in all six. Wrexham’s closing six games were less consistent, bringing two wins, one draw and three defeats, although they kept clean sheets in both victories. The two recent meetings were split, with Wrexham winning 2-0 in March after Swansea’s 2-1 success in December. The total-goals lean is narrowly towards over 2.5 at 52%, with under 2.5 at 48%.
matches.preview_zh: 本場比賽態勢相當接近，Swansea City在模型評估中僅以38%略占優勢，Wrexham AFC為34%，平手則為27%。Swansea上季最後六場英冠賽事取得三勝兩平，且六場皆有進球。Wrexham最後六場比賽的表現較不穩定，取得兩勝一平三敗，不過兩場勝仗都保持零失球。雙方近期兩次交手各勝一場，Wrexham在三月以2比0獲勝，此前Swansea曾在十二月以2比1取勝。總進球數超過2.5球的可能性略高，為52%，低於2.5球則為48%。

matches.preview: The model makes this a finely balanced match, with Wolverhampton Wanderers narrowly favoured to win at 37%, compared with 35% for Birmingham City and 28% for the draw. Birmingham ended last season unbeaten in five matches, including three consecutive home wins, while Wolves finished without a victory in their final six fixtures and recorded three 1-1 draws. The head-to-head record is older history, but Wolves won three of the five meetings listed, including the two most recent in 2017 and 2018. On total goals, the model leans towards under 2.5 at 56%, with over 2.5 at 44%.
matches.preview_zh: 預測模型認為這場比賽勢均力敵，Wolverhampton Wanderers以37%的獲勝機率略占優勢，Birmingham City的獲勝機率為35%，平手機率則為28%。Birmingham上季最後五場比賽保持不敗，其中包括主場三連勝，Wolves則在最後六場比賽未嘗勝績，並有三場以1：1戰平。雙方交手紀錄已較為久遠，但在列出的五次交手中，Wolves贏得三場，包括最近於2017年及2018年的兩次交鋒。總進球數方面，模型認為少於2.5球的機率為56%，多於2.5球則為44%。

matches.preview: Norwich City have the model’s preference at 43%, with Birmingham City on 30% and the draw at 27%. That gives the hosts a clear but measured edge. At the end of last season, Norwich won three of their final six Championship matches, scoring twice in each victory, while Birmingham recorded three wins and two draws across the same six-match span. Birmingham also won the three most recent meetings, including both encounters last season, so the head-to-head history offers Norwich a note of caution. On total goals, the lean is narrowly towards under 2.5 at 51%, compared with 49% for over 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: 模型最看好 Norwich City，勝率為43%，Birmingham City 為30%，平局為27%，因此主隊擁有明確但有限的優勢。上賽季末，Norwich 在最後六場 Championship 比賽中贏得三場，且每場勝仗都攻進兩球；Birmingham 在同期六場比賽則取得三勝二和。Birmingham 也贏下最近三次交手，包括上賽季的兩場對決，因此過往對戰紀錄也提醒 Norwich 仍須謹慎。總進球數方面，少於2.5球的機率以51%略高於多於2.5球的49%。

matches.preview: Oracle90 sees this as finely balanced, with Derby County narrowly favoured at 39%, compared with 32% for a West Bromwich Albion win and 29% for the draw. Derby’s closing six results from last season alternated between wins and defeats, including home victories over Oxford and Stoke. West Brom finished that campaign with three goalless draws in six matches, although they also recorded 3-0 and 2-0 wins. The recent meetings favour Derby: they won four of the five listed encounters, with the latest ending 1-1 in January. The total-goals forecast leans towards under 2.5 goals at 62%, while over 2.5 is 38%.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90認為本場勝負相當接近，Derby County以39%的勝率略占優勢，West Bromwich Albion獲勝的機率為32%，平局則為29%。Derby County上賽季最後六場比賽的結果在勝負之間交替，其中包括主場擊敗Oxford與Stoke。West Bromwich Albion在該賽季最後六場比賽中有三場以零比零收場，不過也曾以三比零與二比零獲勝。近期交手紀錄對Derby County較為有利，在列出的五次交鋒中贏得四場，最近一次則於一月以一比一結束。總進球數方面，少於二點五球的機率為62%，多於二點五球則為38%。

matches.preview: The model narrowly favours Charlton Athletic at 38%, but with Queens Park Rangers at 33% and the draw at 28%, this match is finely balanced. Charlton ended last season with one win in six matches, while QPR lost their final four fixtures, including a 3-0 defeat away to Ipswich. The latest meeting finished 0-0, although QPR won the previous encounter 3-1. Those contrasting head-to-head results add to the uncertainty around the outcome. For total goals, the model leans towards under 2.5 at 57%, compared with 43% for over 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: 模型以38%的機率略微看好Charlton Athletic，但Queens Park Rangers的機率為33%，平局則為28%，顯示本場比賽局勢相當接近。Charlton Athletic上賽季最後六場比賽僅取得一勝，QPR則在最後四場賽事全數落敗，其中包括客場以0比3不敵Ipswich。兩隊最近一次交手以0比0收場，但前一次對決由QPR以3比1獲勝。這些截然不同的交手結果，進一步增加了比賽結果的不確定性。總進球數方面，模型認為低於2.5球的機率為57%，高於2.5球則為43%。
